method.scope: Affected-row recheck only: all changed creative body blocks, one adjacent body block on each side within the H2, surviving deletion boundaries, and explicit time/sequence references affected by the calendar parents. Annotation comments and author/reviewer records were not read. New navigation links were checked as source relationships rather than treating every newly linked scene as rewritten.
method.judgment: The same named common, speech, scripts/screenplay, parent-differentiation and fidelity questions from the initial record apply. A dash tests the applicable questions for that inspected current sentence unit; it is not a renewed whole-H2 or whole-work approval. Repaired prior yes passages receive another yes only for clear failure. Unchanged ambiguous interpretations were not reversed.
method.parent_reading: Current changed treatment/settings/instruction passages were read against baseline. Actual script parents for copying candidates and the relevant treatment H2s were read directly. Unchanged parent text may carry its original reading only after matching the baseline; a current hash alone is not represented as a fresh reading. Parent hashes below inventory the actual inputs, not full-file approval.
method.locators: hN selects h2_order; p counts current annotation-masked Markdown blocks including headings and navigation. Sentence units are punctuation locators, with exact character spans into annotation-masked UTF-8-sig-decoded text; punctuation is not a linguistic parse.
method.quote_policy: Quotes are literal current-source substrings within the cited H2, preserving case and punctuation. NFC plus Unicode-whitespace collapse would be the only allowed normalized fallback; none was used.
unverified: No rebuilt full-population sentence table, fresh full-work closing review or updated historical-source verification is claimed.
No media, measured duration or recorded oral performance was tested.
The unchanged F024 verdict is carried, not reconsidered; other unchanged out-of-scope sentences retain their initial snapshot classifications.
Parent H2 mappings are contextual passages rather than claims of minimal one-to-one semantic alignment.
method.evidence_roles: Members tagged supporting-evidence supply correct parent values or the actual neighboring words; they are not independently classified yes. Only finding-member locations carry the finding, including relational state/sequence candidates.

members.quote: An escort going west and cargo trying to enter the camp meet on the same access road. While each waits for the other to give way, the east asks for more troops. Zheng Mingzhen separates forces to recover the western supply road and hold the front. Sokro cuts communication between the departing escort and the troops remaining. A returning messenger cannot take the original road and turns back. At the western bottleneck, the escort turns toward a new attack from the camp side. Cargo pins the rear of its column in the access road. Those who turn back meet men still pushing west. Beyond their shoulders, Goguryeo infantry takes the mouth of the exit; the eastern alarm continues without an answering formation. The western messenger turns toward the sound of fighting in the east. The road he sees is still blocked.

parent_evidence.quote: As eastern pressure increases, two demands overlap inside. Sokro does not seek to finish the escort head-on; he moves to the route by which contact could be restored. Tang soldiers turn back from the departing escort, but cargo blocks their return. Goguryeo infantry reaches the exit before those men can reform beside the troops still inside. Zheng's orders to close the gap pass through men facing opposite directions.
